description_long: Find commercial real estate listings and office space for rent in the Jackson Square area of San Francisco. Jackson Square is one of the oldest commercial neighborhoods in San Francisco. A collection of three-story brick buildings can be found on the narrow streets and alleys of this historic neighborhood. The neighborhood is home to furniture and decorative art galleries, advertising agencies, architects, graphic designers and law firms. Watering holes, restaurants and clubs dot the streets and alleyways as well.

The Embarcadero was constructed atop an engineered seawall and is the eastern waterfront and roadway for the Port of San Francisco. The Embarcadero begins at Second and King Streets near AT&T Park and continues past the Ferry Building, Fisherman's Wharf and Pier 39 before ending at Pier 45. The Embarcadero Center consists of four 30-45 storey buildings.
